abi.c_signature: FT_Error FT_Set_Var_Design_Coordinates(FT_Face face, FT_UInt num_coords, FT_Fixed* coords)

metadata.coordinate_type: FT_Fixed 16.16 design coordinate for OpenType variations

metadata.source_behavior: Missing axes use defaults, excess values are ignored, and zero/null resets to the current named instance or base font.

fixture_requirements: Three-axis variable font and named-instance control state.

metadata.source_behavior: After successful design-coordinate changes, ftmm.c calls metrics_variations->metrics_adjust when available.

fixture_requirements: Variable font with MVAR plus HVAR or VVAR data.

metadata.source_behavior: The public wrapper returns FT_Err_Invalid_Argument before service lookup when num_coords is nonzero and coords is null.
Design coordinates drive gvar/cvar/HVAR/VVAR/MVAR deltas before glyph metrics, cbox, and rendered output are observed.

fixture_requirements: Project-authored variable font with embedded/intermediate packed gvar records and observable rendered output.
